description: This source file is an implementation class for managing Group Savings Individual Monitoring accounts within the Fineract project. It provides methods for adding account info, updating acceptance status, and counting child accounts.

classes.name: GroupSavingsIndividualMonitoringWritePlatformServiceImpl
classes.description: Implementation of platform service interface for managing Group Savings Individual Monitoring accounts, providing methods to create and update monitoring records.

methods.name: addGSIMAccountInfo
methods.description: Creates and saves a new GroupSavingsIndividualMonitoring record with provided account details.

methods.name: setIsAcceptingChild
methods.description: Updates the specified monitoring record to accept child accounts.

methods.name: resetIsAcceptingChild
methods.description: Updates the specified monitoring record to stop accepting child accounts.

methods.name: incrementChildAccountCount
methods.description: Increments the count of child accounts in the monitoring record.
